checks.explanation: Whether Trump "beat the Deep State" in his second term is genuinely contested: his administration pursued aggressive restructuring of the federal bureaucracy (Schedule F, DOGE-driven mass layoffs, State Department reorganization), which supporters call a real dismantling of the administrative state, while critics argue day-to-day foreign policy continuity (alliances, defense posture, agency inertia) persisted much as Mearsheimer predicted. No clean right/wrong verdict is possible.

checks.explanation: Israel significantly escalated West Bank military operations in 2024-2025 (large-scale raids, settlement expansion), yet Jordan, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia did not militarily intervene, consistent with Mearsheimer's prediction that they lack the capability/will to do so.

The ICJ genocide case (South Africa v. Israel) remains in early procedural stages as of mid-2026 -- Israel filed its counter-memorial in March 2026, with a rejoinder deadline not until 2029 and no hearing on preliminary objections expected before late 2026/2027. No final ICJ or ICC ruling on the Genocide Convention question has been issued yet.
